items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler Zero-Day
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for CVE-2026-75650, which is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation and Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update resolving multiple high-severity vulnerabilities
items.summary: Alongside the critical CVE-2026-71362, APSB26-92 addresses several high-severity vulnerabilities including stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-48414, CVE-2026-48413) that could result in arbitrary code execution, and incorrect authorization issues (CVE-2026-48415, CVE-2026-48416) enabling security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.
